name: BraTS Brain Tumor Segmentation Benchmark
description: Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) is a medical imaging benchmark for segmenting glioma subregions from multi-parametric brain MRI, typically including whole tumor, tumor core, and enhancing tumor regions.
evaluation_method: Dice coefficient and related overlap-based segmentation metrics (often including Hausdorff distance for boundary quality)
notes: Widely used in medical image analysis research; exact split and score conventions vary by BraTS edition.
